stacks.reason: frontend-react with feature-folders is the only stack the web-ui type allows. Its rule features-are-independent keeps each screen (overview, gaps, suggestions, plan, status, history) in its own feature, so a change to how one open business rule is shown touches one feature and no other, and the UI takes rule results from the API instead of computing them (AC-6). Evidence links on gaps, drivers and suggestions (FR-3, FR-4, FR-5) live in the features that show them and can be covered by vitest at the standard's 80% coverage floor (AC-4). TypeScript, bun and vite give one scripted build and test step that a single pipeline run can drive from a clean commit (AC-7). Access control (AC-1) is enforced in the api component, not here.

backend-ts with hexagonal is the only stack the backend-api type allows. Its rules domain-is-pure and application-uses-ports put each open PRD 8 rule (CGM formula, target, thresholds, after point, suggestion source, data and entitlement source) behind one port wired only in src/composition-root.ts, which an import rule check in CI can enforce (AC-6). A pure domain lets the CGM, improvement, shortfall and outcome-label calculations run as table-driven bun test cases over fixtures (AC-5). The source-data adapter can be a read-only outbound port with no write method (AC-2). Plan and status records can be kept append-only in their own adapter, with who and when held in the domain (AC-3). Entitlement checks can sit in one inbound place that every account-scoped route passes through, which the authorization matrix test then covers (AC-1). A single TypeScript service built with bun deploys through the same pipeline as web (AC-7).
